title: Microflow: Microarchitectural Causal Observability for Deep Cross-Layer Analysis and Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2607.13184v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern computer architecture relies heavily on simulation to identify bottlenecks and evaluate optimizations. However, existing microarchitectural performance analysis methods are fundamentally limited by an instruction-centric paradigm that captures only downstream symptoms while leaving the true microarchitectural root cause opaque. Because modern processors are governed by complex interactions across non-instruction entities like prefetchers, replacement policies, and shared queue occupancies, instruction-centric frameworks miss the mechanisms that dictate performance. To eliminate this blind spot, we present Microflow, a framework that achieves causal observability in microarchitectural simulation. To address this, we introduce the Microflow intermediate representation (MFIR), which models execution through microarchitecture-tailored core abstractions such as flows, resource tenancies, and causal edges. translated_title: Microflow：面向深度跨层分析与优化的微架构因果可观测性框架
translated_abstract: 现代计算机体系结构严重依赖仿真来识别瓶颈并评估优化方案。然而，现有的微架构性能分析方法从根本上受限于以指令为中心的范式，该范式只能捕获下游症状，而使真正的微架构根因保持不可见。由于现代处理器的性能由预取器、替换策略和共享队列占用等非指令实体之间的复杂交互所支配，以指令为中心的框架会遗漏那些决定性能的机制。为了消除这一盲点，我们提出了Microflow——一个在微架构仿真中实现因果可观测性的框架。为此，我们引入了Microflow中间表示（MFIR），它通过为微架构量身定制的核心抽象（如流、资源租约和因果边）来建模执行过程。通过编译仿真……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Microflow通过引入微架构中间表示MFIR，以流、资源租约和因果边等核心抽象建模执行过程，突破了以指令为中心的分析范式只能观测下游症状、无法揭示性能根因的局限，实现了微架构仿真中的因果可观测性。
en_tdlr: Microflow introduces a microarchitecture-tailored intermediate representation (MFIR) built on flows, resource tenancies, and causal edges, enabling causal observability in microarchitectural simulation and overcoming the instruction-centric paradigm's inability to reveal true performance root causes.
